description: Operator pushes evidence bundle from a completed job execution. Requires decide authority for the stored job's kernel: its proven operator wallet or the gateway admin authority. A matching claimed operator key gets 403 operator_proof_required. Evidence takes decide, per DECISIONS 2026-10-04 01:25 (N31c). Evidence is posted with the kernel's proven operator wallet authority (decide). The body's kernelId cannot choose the authorization target. No credentials gets 401 before the job read; a job without a kernel gets 403 for a non-admin. Contains device ID, execution timestamp, result payload, and event timeline. Success is a receipt with stored: true naming this jobId. HTTP 200 with stored: false means nothing was stored: never follow it with status completed.
name: operator_push_evidence
